page_title: ATM 4-2 ESP | Atletico Madrid v Espanyol 21/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Exposito (Espanyol) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The resulting corner, taken by Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid), comes to nothing.
89' Exposito (Espanyol) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
86' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) is flagged for offside.
84' Today's match ends for Giuliano Simeone who will be replaced by Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid).
83' Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol) goes into the book and receives a yellow card.

80' 4 - 2 Goal! Exposito (Espanyol) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. Jan Oblak is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 4:2.
80' Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pere Milla (Espanyol) comes onto the pitch for Jofre.
75' Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
74' Here is a change. Antoine Griezmann is going off and Diego Simeone gives the last tactical orders to Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid).
74' Substitution. Marcos Llorente makes his way off the pitch and Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) comes on as his replacement.
72' 4 - 1 Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the left post. Excellent finish.
71' Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol) gets to a rebound on the edge of the box and strikes, but he only hits the crossbar and wastes a promising chance.
70' Espanyol have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
70' Manolo Gonzalez decides to make a substitution. Tyrhys Dolan will be replaced by Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol).
70' Substitution. Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) replaces Kike Garcia.
70' Manolo Gonzalez prepares a substitution. Pol Lozano is replaced by Exposito (Espanyol).
69' OFF THE POST! Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot which smashes against the right post.
67' Good movement by Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
61' The referee signals a substitution. Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is brought on as a substitute for Ademola Lookman.
61' Diego Simeone has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Koke (Atl. Madrid) replacing Alex Baena.
61' Jofre (Espanyol) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Alejandro Ruiz no option but to blow his whistle.
58' 3 - 1 Ademola Lookman (Atl. Madrid) scores a goal with a fine header that goes inside the left post, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
58' The ball goes out of play and it will be a corner kick.
57' Substitution. Clemens Riedel makes way for Ramon Terrats (Espanyol).
54' The attendance for today's match is 56412.
53' The game is interrupted now, Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
53' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
49' 2 - 1 Alex Baena provides Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a low shot into the middle of the goal.
47' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
44' Handball by Ademola Lookman (Atl. Madrid).
41' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
34' Marko Dmitrovic pulls off a brilliant save! Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) launched himself and met a cross into the box, but his header to the right post is saved.
33' A cross by Carlos Romero (Espanyol) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
31' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
31' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) commits a rough challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul.
27' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
25' Ademola Lookman (Atl. Madrid) goes for goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies yards wide of the right post.
22' Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Alejandro Ruiz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
21' 1 - 1 Goal! Marcos Llorente is the provider and Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) is the executioner, dispatching the cross into the right of the goal from close in with his head. 1:1.
16' Jofre (Espanyol) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!

15' Poor effort! The corner picks out Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) completely unmarked in the centre of the box. He has time to pick his spot with the header but makes a mess of it, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
15' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) is about to take a corner kick.
13' A cross from Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
11' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Marko Dmitrovic pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
8' The linesman raises his flag. Kike Garcia (Espanyol) is adjudged offside.
6' 0 - 1 Goal! Tyrhys Dolan displays great vision and sends a pass to Jofre (Espanyol), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball inside the right post. The score is 0:1.
5' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
5' David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) makes a strong challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul.
3' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
3' A pass from Ademola Lookman (Atl. Madrid) is intercepted by Marko Dmitrovic and the move breaks down.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Espanyol will have the kick-off.
Alejandro Ruiz will officiate today.
